description: LIMA AI is the NVDA add-on companion to the LIMA (Low-Vision Intelligent Machine Assistant) desktop app. Press a shortcut and NVDA speaks a brief AI description of the active screen or of the control you are focused on, click any on-screen control just by describing it, and toggle live narration of changes on a web page. Replies can be in English, Tagalog, or Vietnamese.
changelog: New: click an on-screen control just by describing it with NVDA+Alt+C (for example 'click the Send button' or 'open the Downloads folder'); describe the currently focused element with NVDA+Alt+E; Vietnamese added to the reply Language setting; and more reliable AI connections.
